import sys

def main():
    MOD = 1000000007
    p, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    if k > 1:
        order = 1
        while pow(k, order, p) != 1:
            order += 1
        exp = (p - 1) // order
        ans = pow(p, exp, MOD)
        print(ans)
    elif k == 1:
        ans = pow(p, p, MOD)
        print(ans)
    elif k == 0:
        ans = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
